news.title: From SERHAT to the M14: 3E’s night vision ecosystem

bullets: Own product initiatives from problem discovery and requirements through prioritization, planning, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Translate customer, market, and business needs into clear product requirements, priorities, and solution approaches.
Bring structure to ambiguous or inherited problems by clarifying needs, risks, trade-offs, and measures of success.
Balance competing priorities across initiatives while considering customer value, business goals, technical constraints, and timing.
